## Summary
- Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- List commands and results.

## Migration Safety Checklist (Required for migration PRs)
- [ ] Affected tables and functions are listed.
- [ ] Required grants/revokes are listed.
- [ ] Expected application impact is described.
- [ ] Test commands or SQL test cases are included.
- [ ] Rollback notes are included.
- [ ] Intentionally unresolved advisor warnings are listed.
- [ ] Confirmed: no production data is deleted by this migration.
